coverageNotes: Tests missing referenced-row behavior only; does not assess async iteration, a full team scan or app-specific soft-deletion policy.

questions.concept: ID references do not imply row existence
questions.question: What does the query return?

options.rationale: Correct: v.id validates an ID, not continued existence. The team remains and get returns null for its missing admin.
Incorrect: deleting the user does not cascade to teams through v.id references.

options.text: { teamExists: true, admin: U }, with U’s last stored fields.
options.rationale: Incorrect: the stored ID does not retain a snapshot of the referenced document; get returns null after deletion.

options.text: It throws when get("users", team.adminId) finds no document.
options.rationale: Incorrect: a valid ID whose row is missing yields null rather than a missing-row exception.
